name: When is house lifting a necessary renovation, rather than a simpler repair?

mainEntity.name: When is house lifting a necessary renovation, rather than a simpler repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: House lifting becomes necessary when structural damage to a foundation is extensive, when a property is at persistent risk of flooding, or when a major renovation requires a new, deeper foundation or additional stories below the existing structure. Unlike minor foundation repairs, which might involve pier and beam adjustments or slab leveling, lifting the entire house is a comprehensive solution for critical structural compromises or significant elevation changes. Our design-build approach ensures that we thoroughly assess these needs, providing a managed process to determine if house lifting is the most effective long-term solution for enhancing your home's functionality and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: House lifting is necessary for extensive foundation damage, persistent flood risk, or major renovations requiring a new or deeper foundation, going beyond minor repairs.
